reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 6, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: Look at the graph. What is the value for dogs?
Look at the graph. What is the value for grapes?
Create a graph to show: Grade 1: 45, Grade 2: 45, Grade 3: 60, Grade 4: 70.
Look at the graph. What is the value for swimming?
Look at the graph. What is the value for dogs?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: 'Present' means constructing a table/graph from given data, but 4 of the 5 samples (seeds 42, 43, 45, 46) instead ask the student to read an existing graph, e.g. 'Look at the graph. What is the value for dogs?'; only seed 44's 'Create a graph to show: Grade 1: 45, Grade 2: 45, Grade 3: 60, Grade 4: 70.' actually asks the student to present data.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: No sample ever frames a plain data table to be filled in or built, so the 'tables' half of 'tables and single bar graphs' is never covered, and only one construction task exists among the five samples.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Both reading a labeled category's value (grapes = 15 in seed 43) and filling four given values (45, 45, 60, 70) into a graph are grade-3 quarter-3 appropriate demands.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: 80% of the samples (seeds 42, 43, 45, 46) share one 'Look at the graph. What is the value for X?' template that tests reading, not presenting, leaving essentially one genuine presenting-type item in the whole set.

competency_alignment.rationale: The dominant observed variation -- which category's value is being read: dogs, grapes, swimming -- belongs to the sibling 'interpret' competency's axis, not to 'present', so most of this node's samples build the wrong skill.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The values involved, single/double-digit reads like the swimming value of 25 and the four-value construction set 45/45/60/70, sit in a grade-3-appropriate range regardless of the framing mismatch.
